meta.title: Mobility Within Campus
meta.description: Everyday services on the XLRI Delhi-NCR campus: the hostel gymnasium, an ICICI e-lobby and SBI branch, a free student shuttle and XL Salon.

title: Mobility Within Campus
intro: The everyday services students need are on campus, a short walk from class and the hostel — a gym, two banks, a salon and a free shuttle.

services.title: Gymnasium
services.description: In the hostel itself there is a large Gym available to use for all students.

photos.alt: Weight machines, benches and a dumbbell rack in the hostel gym
A row of treadmills and cross-trainers by the gym windows
A leg-press machine and cable station in the gym

services.title: ICICI E-Lobby
services.description: There are 2 banking facilities on campus, one of them is the ICICI E-Lobby.

photos.alt: The campus building that houses the ICICI Bank e-lobby and the XL Salon

services.title: Shuttle Service
services.description: XLRI Delhi NCR Campus provides a complimentary shuttle service for students.

photos.alt: The white XLRI campus shuttle van

services.title: XL Salon
services.description: The XLRI Delhi campus offers a comprehensive range of grooming services to ensure that students can maintain their personal appearance with ease and convenience.

photos.alt: Salon chairs facing mirrors and shelves of products at XL Salon
The length of the salon, with styling stations along one wall
Two styling chairs under ring lights at XL Salon

services.title: SBI Bank Branch
services.description: A full State Bank of India branch, with its own ATM, on the campus.
